content.value: The input to an 11 KV, 3-phase, star connected synchronous motor is 60 A. The effective resistance and synchronous reactance per phase are 1 Ω and 30 Ω, respectively. Find (i) power supplied to the motor (ii) mechanical power developed and (iii) induced emf for a PF of 0.8 leading.
